IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: Advancement of education at San Diego Community College District
IRS990.MissionDesc: SAN DIEGO CONTINUING EDUCATION COMMITS TO STUDENT SUCCESS AND COMMUNITY ENRICHMENT BY PROVIDING ACCESSIBLE AND INNOVATIVE QUALITY EDUCATION AND SUPPORT SERVICES TO DIVERSE ADULT LEARNERS IN PURSUIT OF LEARNING, TRAINING, CAREER ADVANCEMENT, AND PATHWAYS TO COLLEGE.
IRS990.Desc: THE SDCEF SAN DIEGO CONTINUING EDUCATION FOUNDATION SUPPORTS THE GOALS OF SAN DEIGO CONTINUING EDUCATION, WHICH IS THE ADULT EDUCATION, NONCREDIT PROGRAM WITHIN THE SAN DIEGO COMMUNITY COLLEGE DISTRICT SDCCD. CONTINUING EDUCATION REPRESENTS A DIVERSE POPULATION OF SAN DIEGANS AND IS THE OLDEST AND LARGEST NONCREDIT INSTITUTION IN THE NATION. SOME OF THE PRIMARY PURPOSES OF SDCEF INCLUDE: THE ADVANCEMENT OF EDUCATION THE INSTRUCTION AND TRAINING OF INDIVIDUALS IN VARIOUS VOCATIONAL AND ACADEMIC DISCIPLINES THE DEVELOPMENT OF RESEARCH AND EDUCATION PROJECTS AND SPECIAL EDUCATIONAL AND COMMUNITY SERVICE PROGRAMS A PROVISION OF SCHOLARSHIPS TO ELIGIBLE INDIVIDUALS IN ORDER TO ASSIST THEM IN IMPROVING AND DEVELOPING THEIR CAPABILITIES SOLICITATION AND RASING OF MONEY FOR THE PURPOSE OF AWARDING SCHOLARSHIPS AND LOANS TO ASSIST STUDENTS IN PURSUING AN EDUCATION.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: OPERATION OF THE EMPLOYEE TRAINING INSTITUTE ETI AS ANOTHER OPTION OF CONTINUAL EDUCATION. ETI PROVIDES THE TOOLS NECESSARY TO AIDE INDIVIDUALS IN BECOMING LIFE-LONG LEARNERS BY SUPPORTING GOALS THAT CAN RANGE FROM CAREER DEVELOPMENT THROUGH THE ACQUISITION OF NEW SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE TO PERSONAL ENRICHMENT AIMED AT A HOBBY OR FULFILLING A PASSION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The Foundation has adopted FASB ASC Topic 740 that clarifies the accounting for uncertainty in tax positions taken or expected to be taken on a tax return and provides that the tax effects from an uncertain tax position can be recognized in the financial statements only if, based on its merits, the position is more likely than not to be sustained on audit by the taxing authorities. Management believes that all tax positions taken to date are highly certain and, accordingly, no accounting adjustment has been made to the financial statements. The Foundation would recognize future accrued interest and penalties related to unrecognized tax benefits and liabilities in income tax expense if such interest and penalties are incurred.

SCHOLARSHIPS AND STUDENT FEES ARE AWARDED ON THE BASIS OF THE NEEDS AND RELATIVE MERITS OF THE APPLICANTS. SCHOLARSHIPS ARE FOR STUDENTS IN GOOD STANDING WITH EXCELLENT ATTENDANCE AND EACH HAS DIFFERENT REQUIREMENTS MONITORED BY THE SDCEF.
